http/server_policy#

What a server allows itself: protocols, limits, timeouts, connections and ranges per request.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

HttpServer(listener: listener, handling: app, policy: ServerPolicy(
    protocols: OrderedSet([HttpVersion.http_1_1, HttpVersion.http_2]),
    limits: HttpLimits(),
    timeouts: ServerTimeouts(),
    connections: 256,
    ranges: 16,
));

Description#

What a server allows itself: protocols, limits, timeouts, connections and ranges per request.

By default: HTTP/1.1, the default HttpLimits, 64 connections, 16 ranges per request, 30 seconds for the head, each pause in a body and a handler, and 5 seconds of keep-alive.
